name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform that centralizes customer data across sales, service, marketing, and IT so teams share one view of the customer, with AI layered in for automation and assistance.
best_for: Salesforce markets itself for companies of any size wanting a single, AI-enabled platform unifying sales, service, marketing, and IT — from small businesses up through large enterprises.
features: AI agents for autonomous task handling

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform with a free tier covering contact, deal, and pipeline management alongside marketing and service tools.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and small businesses that want to start free and scale up

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual pipeline for tracking leads and deals.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized sales teams wanting a simpler, sales-first tool
